claim: On 2026-05-12 the CloudFront Premium flat-rate plan began to offer self-service monthly usage levels from 500 million to 6 billion requests and from 50 TB to 600 TB, so customers can scale within the plan as their applications grow.
question: When did the CloudFront Premium flat-rate plan get configurable usage allowances, and what range do they cover?

qualifiers.condition: each usage level has its own monthly flat-rate price; usage allowances of the Free, Pro and Business plans are not configurable

evidence.quote: Now, the Premium plan offers a range of self-service monthly usage levels ranging from 500 million to 6 billion requests and 50 TB to 600 TB, so customers can scale within the plan as their applications grow.
Configurable usage allowances are available only on the Premium plan. Usage allowances on Free, Pro, and Business plans are not configurable.

evidence.heading: Amazon CloudFront Premium flat-rate plan now supports configurable usage allowances

note: d130. Examinable (before 2026-07-15) but recognition only. The post says the plan previously supported a single usage allowance; that sentence cannot be quoted (page-furniture check on the words 'contact us').
